notes.title: Tokyo's Neon Monsters - Play test
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! 
We're excited to release the demo of our very first game, and we'd love for you to try it and share your thoughts. Your feedback is incredibly important and will help us improve the game in meaningful ways.[/p][p]We're aiming to involve our small community in shaping the future of the project. Whether you have ideas, suggestions, or even criticisms, your input is invaluable to us.[/p][p]You can talk to us directly on Discord or join the discussion on our Steam community page.[/p][p]Don't forget to wishlist the game so you stay updated on future announcements. We're building this game together, and your voice matters.[/p][p]Thank you for playing the Tokyo's Neon Monsters demo![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415211/a5f3e4898053ba1fd479fa970d4e786609f45df8.png"][/img][/p]
